recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a modern profile publisher or external IG again generates documentation that diverges from StructureDefinition XML, treat it as a new tooling or owning-IG issue with a current reproducible artifact rather than changing current FHIR core source for this DSTU1 roll-up.
issue_request: FHIR-7790 asked that generated profile documentation be based on profile XML rather than independently on spreadsheets, after QICore profile documentation could look correct while the XML had hidden snapshot/differential errors. The Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution says the reported issues were resolved in tooling and/or declarations.
initial_application: No migrated Git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-7790. The Jira comment cites FHIR-5980, FHIR-5988, and FHIR-5580 as related reported defects; those issues record historical tooling, spreadsheet declaration, or element-ordering fixes, and the combined branch already contains separate no-change audit commits for all three cited child issues.
additional_context: The affected examples were historical QICore and DAF generated profile pages from DSTU1. Current source/fhir.ini has no active QICore or DAF profile entry, source/igs.xml comments out the old DAF and QICore IG entries, and current core source already documents the relevant ElementDefinition.mustSupport and ElementDefinition.isModifier semantics. Zulip and Confluence searches found no record that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. An empty no-change audit commit was published on the combined branch because changing current core prose or disabled historical IG material would not improve current implementer understanding.
